name: erp_invoices_list
description: List invoice transactions (AR), optionally filtered by status, customer entity or originating sales order (GET /services/rest/record/v1/invoice)

status.description: Invoice status filter: open, paid or voided.

created_from.description: Originating sales order tranId (createdFrom), e.g. SO-2026-0105.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).
